[page२-195+ ४३] Prepared for the इन्द्रयाग; but gave it up and prayed to the mountains instead, as advised by कृष्ण; Indra's anger towards Nanda; was surprised at कृष्ण holding the Govar- dhana; when the Gopas wondered at the exploits of the boy, कृष्ण, Nanda said that he heard from Garga that he was Vasudeva's son and an अम्श of नारायण; after fasting on एकादशि, Nanda went to यमुना for bath for the द्वादशि; it was आसुर time and not the time for bath; so an Asura follower of वरुण took hold of him and placed him before वरुण; seeing Nanda missing, the Gopas got frightened and appealed to कृष्ण who went to वरुण; pleased at seeing him वरुण said that it was a mistake committed by his servants in ignorance and set Nanda free; then he returned to Vraja to the great joy of all the Gopas; taken to Brahmah- rada;
